package.title: Agent Reliability — interfaceよりscaffolding、成功率より失敗の構造
package.purpose: agent systemの評価を、interfaceの印象ではなく、scaffolding、requirements/planning、function-call diagnosis、transaction semantics、red teaming、skill-induced regressionの失敗構造として統合する。
must_cover_requirements: scaffolding/interface effects、requirements/planning、function-call diagnosis、executable red teaming、transaction semantics、skill-induced regressionsを別の評価対象として整理する。
benchmarkやenvironmentのscopeとauthor-report attributionを保持し、六本のpaper summary listにしない。
成功率の大小ではなく、失敗がinterface、planning、tool call、transaction、red-team環境、skillにどこから発生するかをpackageの比較軸にする。
読者が問うべき『agentが賢いか』から『agent systemのどの層を測り、どの失敗を再現可能にするか』への問いを提示する。

rows.title: Repowise evidence-backed codebase intelligence and benchmark method
remaining_boundaries: The benchmark materials report small samples, including n=6 short tasks and n=5 long tasks, and describe the results as directional.

The materials document judge noise, including a 0.69-point disagreement noise floor on django and a paired-delta standard deviation of 2.23 on one arm; judge-score differences are not a general quality result.
Prompt-caching sensitivity affects absolute cache-write and cost values; the project presents tool calls, files read, and cache-read tokens as more robust within the reported setup.

The retrieval and agent-loop results are scoped to pinned repositories and tasks, including django/django or pallets/flask at one commit, and do not establish general task success or quality equivalence.
Some hosted rows require subscriptions, API keys, or other credentials, and the checkout alone does not reproduce every reported row; no independent rerun is claimed in this card.

A qualifying W33 event or publication chronology remains unresolved in the bound source set; that limitation supports a later non-material editorial disposition and is not treated as proof of a W33 event.
The bound Repowise source set establishes project and benchmark methodology but does not establish an exact qualifying W33 event or publication chronology.

profile_extensions.why_this_issue: This closes the carry-over obligation without presenting RepoWise as a W33 development: its project and method facts remain auditable, while the unresolved chronology and lack of a qualifying W33 delta support non-inclusion.
It gives the issue an infrastructure-level counterpart to model announcements: model availability depends on serving support, cache behavior, and the runtime path that the release changes.
